title.title: The Bunjo
title.overview: The Bunjo, by Grady Behrhorst, is an 8 minute proof of concept film and simply a masterpiece. The film leaves you questioning your religion, your sexuality, reality and the role of the commonwealth in your life. No film that I’ve ever seen has held such philosophical commentary.

similar.title: Fight Dirty
similar.overview: When wealthy Queen Bee Kenzie makes a deal with high school bad boy Clay to be her fake boyfriend and bodyguard, she unknowingly steps into his dangerous world of illegal underground fighting - quickly igniting an undeniable attraction.

similar.title: Night Nurse
similar.subtitle: 2026 • NR
similar.overview: As a series of perverse scam calls unsettles an idyllic retirement community, a starry-eyed nurse becomes entangled with her mysterious patient.

similar.title: Kill Me
similar.overview: Jimmy wakes up in a bathtub after having tried to kill himself. Or, at least, that’s what it looks like to his friends and family. Jimmy is pretty sure he didn’t do it… maybe. Together with Margot, the 911 operator who took his call, Jimmy sets out on a mission to solve a vitally important whodunit: did someone try to kill him, or are they chasing the spectre of depression?

similar.title: Barrio Triste
similar.overview: On the outskirts of Medellín, Colombia in the late 1980s, local residents report strange lights descending from the sky. When a reporter arrives to investigate, a ragtag group of teens from a lawless neighbourhood storm the scene and steal his camera. In the hands of its new owners, the device records a mesmerising plunge into their frantic existence.

similar.title: The Locket
similar.overview: People from different eras of time are transported to the present day by this strange locket passed through the generations. How do they return and if not can they cope in their new environment?

similar.title: ASLEEP
similar.subtitle: 2025 • NR
similar.overview: A depressed girl daydreams of being abducted by aliens to escape her mental torment.

similar.title: Devour
similar.overview: A struggling all female metal band called "The Virginia Bitches" have a taste for blood and while on tour their van breaks down in the middle of nowhere. Seeking help they come across a town full of cannibals led by an infamous Warlock.

similar.title: The Amazing Digital Circus: The Last Act
similar.subtitle: 2026 • NR
similar.overview: With Caine gone and the circus dark, the cast are left with only the mistakes and traumas of their pasts to keep them company. As the prospect of eternity closes in around them, they discover the truth about the Digital Circus and its history. Will they come to terms with what they uncover, or will they make... the other choice? Also, presumably at some point someone says something funny, because this ending can’t be THAT depressing, can it? A theatrical screening of episode 8 and the all new, hour-long episode 9.
